description: This file contains a test suite class 'EntityCryptoTestSuite' for testing cryptographic functionalities of entity encryption, decryption, and related query behaviors within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for testing basic crypto operations, encryption correctness, lookup scenarios, and sub-select queries involving encrypted data.

classes.name: EntityCryptoTestSuite
classes.description: A JUnit test suite class for testing encryption and decryption mechanisms on entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testCrypto
methods.description: Tests basic encryption and decryption of entity fields, verifying data consistency after storage and refresh.

methods.name: testCryptoEncryption
methods.description: Verifies that encryption is applied correctly during save, that raw encrypted values differ from plain text, and that multiple stores yield different encrypted outputs for the same plaintext.

methods.name: testCryptoLookup
methods.description: Tests lookup and querying functionalities with encrypted fields, including null value behavior and filtering based on encrypted data.

methods.name: makeSubSelectCondition
methods.description: Creates an entity condition with sub-select criteria for testing.

methods.name: makeSubSelect
methods.description: Builds an EntityConditionSubSelect object for performing sub-select queries.

methods.name: testCryptoSubSelect
methods.description: Validates sub-select query operations involving encrypted fields, including filtering by sub-conditions and verifying query results.
